nodes.procedure: Water-Plasma-Enabled Exfoliation of Ultrathin Layered Double Hydroxide Nanosheets with Multivacancies for Water Oxidation. Nanosheets of Co3O4 with oxygen vacancies and CoFe LDH nanosheets with multiple vacancies were created using water plasma (direct-barrier-discharge (DBD) plasmas in water vapour).

nodes.description: HER and OER performance in 1.0 M KOH
nodes.source_text: The fabricated NiCoP nanosheet (NS) showed minimum potential values of 32 & 280mV@10mA / cm^2 towards hydrogen and oxygen generation reaction, respectively.

the advanced plasma treatment reduces -Co(OH)2 NS into P-Co(OH)2 , which demonstrates a significant rise towards HER performance. They also have a small Tafel slope and overpotential values. Additionally, in a continuous 50-h, HER treatment, P-Co(OH)2 showed exceptional stability, when studied for bi-functional electroactivity. Here, the minimum voltage required is 1.48V to generate 10mA / cm^2 . Remarkably, the developed catalyst can function at 10mA / cm^2 for as long as 850h without deterioration in its performance.

Rong et al. [56] fabricated La/Ce doped CoFe LDH composites using co-precipitation and hydrothermal methods, achieving a good performance of 317mV@10 mA / cm^2 and 125mV / dec in the Tafel slope value
In high potential, NiFeV demonstrated a low Tafel slope and the best OER performance.
The hybrid NiFe-LDH/ CNTs offer low overpotential values of 234mV @ 10mA/cm^2 and high durability for up to 37 hrs without a negligible current loss
they performed better at room temperature in terms of O2 evolution. ... exhibits a low Tafel value of around 33mV/ dec, the lowest overpotentials of 227mV @ 10mA/cm^2
